title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-07-31
lineage: AudMC(AKG 1000 mic > Sony 110 deck, TDK C-120SD master cassettes)  > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: An electrifying July 31 1973 Roosevelt Stadium audience tape that captures a birthday‑charged show with Black Peter, Loose Lucy and a blistering China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) capture that many listeners describe as clear, lively and full of crowd ambience – even if the PA was a bit "tinny" it still delivers excellent presence.  Musically the show is consistently praised for its high‑energy first set and an incendiary second set highlighted by Black Peter, Loose Lucy, China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, a Promised Land > Bertha > Greatest Story Ever Told medley and a soaring Truckin'.  Jerry Garcia’s birthday celebration adds an extra layer of excitement, with strong contributions from Phil Lesh and the rest of the band.

ai_rating.rationale: 18 reviews (13 × 5‑star, 5 × 4‑star) uniformly praise both performance and audio; the consensus is a top‑tier show with an excellent audience recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crowd noise is prominent but adds immediacy; sound is generally clear and well‑balanced despite a slightly tinny PA. Reviewers note the tape captures the energy of the room, with occasional EQ recommendations for optimal playback.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Promised Land > Bertha > Greatest Story Ever Told
show_quality.setlist_flow: The first set builds strong momentum that bursts into an explosive second set; birthday celebrations and audience participation heighten the flow, making the concert feel like a continuous, high‑energy party.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his birthday-fueled playing – "party hard", "busted loose" on Truckin', superb guitar tone and overall fire.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for an impressive bass solo around the 9‑minute mark and for making the floor vibrate with his chord work.
